title: Breha Organa
subtitle: House Organa
description: As Queen of Alderaan and head of the planet's royal family, Breha Organa had many worries in the galaxy. When her husband, Senator Bail Organa, arrived with a little girl to adopt, Leia Skywalker became Princess Leia Organa. She set herself to the task of preparing young Leia for the ability to be a leader in a harsh world, while also working to help establish a rebellion against the Empire.
